prerequisites.evidence: Prerequisite: CSC 210 or CSC 215 with a grade of C or better.

other_requirements.evidence: Prerequisite: CSC 210 or CSC 215 with a grade of C or better.

learning_outcomes: Revise, apply and master the fundamentals of Java programming, including object-oriented principles, to effectively implement and manipulate various data structures.
Apply the principles of object-oriented programming, such as inheritance, polymorphism, and encapsulation, in the design and implementation of robust data structures.
Understand and utilize advanced object-oriented programming concepts such as inheritance, polymorphism, and interfaces to design and manage data structures in Java.
Implement key data structures, including arrays, linked lists, stacks, queues, and dictionaries, using Java, with a focus on their practical applications.
Analyze the structure and functionality of Abstract Data Types (ADTs) and develop custom implementations using Java Collections and basic programming techniques.
Analyze and evaluate the time and space complexity of various data structures and algorithms.
Implement and manipulate fundamental data structures such as arrays, linked lists, stacks, queues, trees, and graphs in a high-level programming language.
Evaluate the performance of different data structures through an understanding of time complexity and space complexity, without delving into detailed algorithmic analysis.
Design and apply recursive techniques where appropriate in data structure operations, recognizing its use and limitations in Java.
Debug and manage Java exceptions to ensure the reliability and robustness of data structure implementations.
Develop a strong foundation in data structures, a critical component in technical interviews and job roles across top tech companies.
Master the data structures concepts and problem-solving techniques that are frequently tested in coding interviews.
Learn how to design and implement data structures that enhance the efficiency and scalability of real-world applications.
Grasp the underlying principles of data structures and their applications, giving you the confidence to tackle complex programming challenges in your career.
topics: Java history, OOP basics and Data Structure
Introduction to Algorithm Analysis, Time Complexity, and Big O
Preparing for Future: Industry Guest Lecture
